important_evidence: AMPScanner vr.2 uses DNN with convolutional and LSTM layers, available as web server, used in PMID 37851665 and 39203524.
PepGen 1.0 is an LSTM-based AMP generator, trained on AMP sequences to generate 3006 peptides, used in PMID 40643674.
AmPepGen is a GAN-based AMP generator, code available at https://github.com/Anorpe/ampepgen-dev, used in PMID 40643674.
